primary_analysis: Mean within-model-depth ordered signed Spearman correlation between cosine geometry and signed causal transfer.
primary_permutation_test: Exact 7! behavior-label permutation. The same semantic label permutation is applied synchronously across blocks.
p_value_definition: Two-sided exact permutation p-value including the identity permutation.
iid_note: Standard IID correlation p-values are not used because geometry is symmetric while transfer is directional and the same behaviors recur across layers/models.
